method: Built-in image_gen, transparent_background=true. Existing faction banners supplied only as style/material references.
emblem_horde:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a standalone heraldic appliqué badge for a painted fantasy game guild banner, one single original emblem, transparent PNG1024x1024.
REFERENCE IMAGE ROLE: supplied banner is a STYLE AND MATERIAL REFERENCE ONLY. Match its exact hand-painted high-fantasy rendering, stylized detailed painterly surface, metallic highlight treatment, warm upper-left rim lighting, shallow raised forms with soft contact shadows on the object itself. Do not depict the banner or pole.
COMPOSITION: perfectly front-facing circular badge, no tilt or perspective. Disc center exactly(512,512). Outer circle diameter942pixels,92% of canvas width, extending x41–983 and y41–983. Entire object INCLUDING all ornament, spikes, rays, stitching and rim stays INSIDE that circle. All surrounding pixels genuinely transparent alpha0. Nothing extends outside the round silhouette. No hanging straps or pendants, no external shadow, no floor, no scenery, no background, no smoke or floating specks.
DESIGN LANGUAGE: a sewn-on heraldic appliqué with a dark supporting disc, shallow embossed raised main design and THIN metallic rim, very subtle short attachment stitches just inside the rim. Bold simple masses and clear empty dark separation, recognisable when the entire icon is only60pixels wide. Keep small detailing subordinate, avoid busy micro-ornament or many tiny scratches. NO text, letters, numbers, runes or watermarks.
Create ORIGINAL heraldry. Do not copy, imitate, reference or incorporate official Horde or Alliance logos from World of Warcraft or any existing game logo. Borrow only the broad fantasy mood.
SPECIFIC EMBLEM: fierce martial mood for a red banner. Blackened iron circular disc, thin dark bronze rim with8 restrained rivets. A large symmetric FRONT-VIEW TUSKED ORC WAR MASK is the unmistakable central focus: strong angry brow, angular cheek plates, deep dark eye sockets, broad blunt nose and TWO powerful upturned lower tusks. This is a crafted mask in BONE WHITE with restrained dull-gold inlays, not a living face or skull. Its silhouette reads at60px.
Behind the mask, TWO distinct crossed war axes form a clear X, with broad dull-gold and bone-white axe blades visible in the upper left and upper right quadrants and short wrapped handles visible below the mask. Add only a few simple short tribal spikes around the mask inside the disc. Keep axes and spikes fully inside the rim. Use the supplied red banner's aged metal/bone/leather material palette and rugged painted craftsmanship, but keep the badge background black iron. No red faction logo, no pre-existing crest. Output file emblem_horde.png,1024x1024 RGBA.

SPECIFIC EMBLEM: noble knightly mood for a blue banner. Dark navy circular disc, thin polished GOLD rim with only small restrained filigree details. Original design in luminous GOLD and SILVER: a large simple upright kite shield occupying the middle, overlaid by a single straight UPRIGHT KNIGHT'S SWORD pointed upward along the exact vertical centerline. The sword is clearly in FRONT of the shield, with broad bright silver blade, strong simple golden crossguard and compact grip/pommel. The kite shield has a silver face and warm gold outline, its bottom point clear. A small simple gold crown floats directly above the sword tip, separate from it. Several broad, simple gold rays of light fan out BEHIND the shield and sword, all contained within the circular disc. Dark negative spaces separate the rays, shield, sword and crown. No lion, animal head, wings, fleur-de-lis or existing heraldic logo. Match the reference banner's elegant golden craftsmanship and painterly royal palette. Strong clear silhouette, read the sword and shield at60px. Output file emblem_alliance.png,1024x1024 RGBA.
